title: Fixed Open Bay and Parked Connector Charge Post
description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed charging-post-style public-service exterior. A broad finite ground foot carries one continuous thick tapered-shoulder upright with a genuine tall through-open lower bay and integral solid upper control head. A complete heavy-looking cable leaves the left side, forms a deep uninterrupted hanging loop around the lower open bay and ends in one independent canted grip beneath a parked axial connector. That connector has a complete thick annular mouth, real blind inner cavity, small blunt recessed contact appearances and whole rear cap; a separate short side holster roots it to the upright. A blank opaque upper control plaque and small separate round blank indicator complete the one assembly. Unlike the old finned inverter this has no rear fin field or array of fixed blind sockets, and unlike the hooded telephone it has no keypad, recessed handset booth or double-ended receiver. The full through-bay, lower continuous cable route and independent axial connector/side park relation are newly authored together, not an imported cabinet with a renamed handset. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal-bounds-centred ground sole, one prop zero scenes. No vehicle, battery, circuit, charging, voltage, power delivery, connector standard or insertion fit, cable tension, powered display, payment, weather protection, electrical safety, manufacture or installation performance made or verified. Fixed static visual appearance only; rigging animation interaction absent.
